description: This file contains utility functions related to tree data structures used in PyTorch's export system, including a function to reorder keyword arguments based on a specification and a function to check the equivalence of two TreeSpec objects.

classes.name: TreeSpec
classes.description: Represents the specification of a tree structure in PyTorch's export system, including type, number of children, and context.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] reorder_kwargs(user_kwargs: dict[str, Any], spec: TreeSpec)
methods.description: Reorders user-provided keyword arguments to match the order specified in a TreeSpec. Ensures consistent argument ordering for exported programs.

methods.name: bool is_equivalent( spec1: TreeSpec, spec2: TreeSpec, equivalence_fn: Callable[[type | None, Context, type | None, Context], bool], )
methods.description: Checks whether two TreeSpec objects are equivalent based on a provided comparison function, recursively examining their structure and types.

ctags.name: is_equivalent
ctags.signature: ( spec1: TreeSpec, spec2: TreeSpec, equivalence_fn: Callable[[type | None, Context, type | None, Context], bool], )

ctags.name: reorder_kwargs
ctags.pattern: /^def reorder_kwargs(user_kwargs: dict[str, Any], spec: TreeSpec) -> dict[str, Any]:$/
